summary: Built out the client side of the conversation feature: clipboard helper, message-row builder, scroll-follow logic, row-measure ResizeObserver hook, ThreadEvent component, and a rewritten MessageList.svelte driven by a TanStack virtualizer. Created ToolCallCard, usage helpers, tool-call styles, and an Extensions settings page; applied a Python patch script to wire copyToClipboard and adjust fake-client event kinds. Formatted, type-checked (5341 files, 0 errors), built, started the web server, and verified the home and Extensions pages via Playwright screenshots driven through playwright-core.
decisions: Implemented copy-to-clipboard as a custom helper that falls back to a hidden textarea + document.execCommand('copy') because navigator.clipboard is only available in secure contexts.
Modelled messages as a row list (message-rows.ts) with separate kinds for content and tool entries, so the virtualizer and follow logic operate on one stream.
Treated being within 24px of the bottom as "at the bottom" for follow logic, with pointer/touch handlers to suppress auto-follow while the user scrolls.
Used a ResizeObserver-based row measure hook (row-measure.ts) so streaming content height changes remeasure the virtualizer row.
Mapped the fake client's session.compaction emission to message.role === 'event' with kind 'compaction' so it renders via ThreadEvent.
Patched session-actions.svelte.ts and SessionTreeScreen.svelte to import copyToClipboard from the new clipboard module.
Drove UI verification through playwright-core loaded from another project's node_modules since no preview MCP host was available, capturing screenshots of the home and Extensions pages.
errors: Initial headless Chrome screenshot attempt exited with code 2 and produced no file, so verification was switched to a playwright-core script.

First web-server start attempt failed because ports 4173 and 8787 were held by orphaned node processes from earlier sessions; an attempt to stop them timed out, after which a later start picked up new processes on those ports.
mcp__t3-code__preview_open and preview_status returned "No preview automation host is available" in this environment.
